scenario: Web 应用安全扫描器触发大量探测告警（误报）

judgment.summary: Detected SQLi/XSS signatures originate from authorized internal AppScan scanner (10.0.5.110). Asset info and threat intelligence confirm this is legitimate security operations activity, not malicious attack.
evidence_chain: WAF alert details show SQL injection and XSS vectors from source IP 10.0.5.110 (query_alert_detail)
Asset information confirms 10.0.5.110 is hostname appsec-scanner-01, department InfoSec, tagged as scanner and authorized (query_asset_info)
Threat intelligence indicates IP 10.0.5.110 is not malicious with reputation score 100 and source Internal (query_threat_intel)
No related malicious alerts found in 48h window indicating isolated scanning activity (query_related_alerts)

iocs.context: Authorized internal AppScan scanner confirmed by asset and threat intel

remediation: Add IP 10.0.5.110 to WAF whitelist or create exclusion rule for vulnerability scanning signatures to suppress future alerts.
Verify current scan scope and schedule with InfoSec department owner (appsec@company.com) to ensure alignment with business policy.
Update asset inventory tags to automatically classify traffic from this IP as trusted in SIEM/WAF correlation rules.

actual: Add IP 10.0.5.110 to WAF whitelist or create exclusion rule for vulnerability scanning signatures to suppress future alerts.
